We had a front loader for 15 years.  In November, we switched back to a top loader.  During the spin cycle, it was very loud and manipulated itself a lot to balance the load.  And during all that, it would crawl a good bit across the concrete basement floor.  (The floor is a bit slanted as the drain is several feet from the area.)  I found myself having to move the washer back into place, every 3 or 4 days.  Because of the slanted floor, I didn't expect these pads to make much of a difference, but figured it was worth a shot.  And boy, they have exceeded my hopes.  The first load I put in, was a bunch of towels.  I wanted to give it a good max test right outta the gate.  It didn't crawl at all, and I didn't hear a thing upstairs!  In fact, I forgot the washer was even on.  Normally, with towels, jeans, etc, I would hear that spin cycle banging all the way upstairs!  Great product!!!
These are sturdy and they do a great job of keeping heavy things in place.
I wish I had known about this product a long time ago. No more washing machine jumping across the floor!  Much quieter now.
These had the worst chemical smell that it caused an asthma reaction. I also had to pay postage to return them.
These pads work like a charm. They keep the washer and dryer as steady as a rock even under the most strenuous loads.
Really stopped the movement and noise
It smells so strong and bad. It is toxic. Do not recommend
Bought for a washer/dryer located in a closet next to my kitchen. I could not use due to the strong chemical smell. I would not recommend unless you are thinking bout using them outdoors.
Works great.

When I received the package I already knew what it was by the odor. The pads were within its own package in the shipment box and I can smell the horrible smell of rubber. I purchased 2 sets totaling 8 pads. I left them outside on my enclosed porch to let them air out for a week. That didn't help much so I washed the pads with concentrated dish soap several times. After drying them I put the pads back outside for another week. To this day the pads smell as bad as they did when I opened the box. Its an overwhelming smell of rubber. Just being within a few feet of the pads is too much for me. My washer & dryer is next to the kitchen so I would be smelling this all day. If your appliances are in the basement then I guess it wouldn't be as terrible. I regret buying these pads. Also, the pads are very tall. It would have been better if they were made 1/4" high and coated to seal the rubber. Pads are way over-priced. Save your money and look for another alternative or just do lighter wash loads.
Very heavy looks like hockey pucks , but it work just as it says , very happy with this products
These vibration dampeners did a real good job with our LG front loader washer vibration.  Far superior to the junk we tried from Lowes.  I would recomend!

We recently got a front-loader washer/dryer set.  The washer spins at a very high RPM.  Every time the washer went into the spin cycle, it vibrated and pounded the floor so much that I thought it was going to cause the laminate floor to disintegrate.  I ordered these pads and was glad for the quick delivery so she didn't have to do any more loads.  I installed the pads and watched the washer for a few loads.  At first I thought it was just luck that the balance was just right, but, no.  There was no bounce and no walking.  I delayed writing a raving review until a few more loads were washed.  AMAZING !!!  NO BOUNCE  !!!  I had told my wife at first to let me know when it went into the spin cycle, but it was so quiet that she didn't even notice it.  I had to walk in there every once in awhile to check on it for several loads.  Also, they fit the feet of the washer perfectly so they never get off-center.

Bought two sets, for under washer and dryer. NOTICEABLE sound difference / reduction, despite both machines already being quite quiet. Spin cycle vibrations don't carry out of the washing room. Solid product, with nice little feet cut ins to keep in place.

Product was larger then picture represents. However, the product works great. Our washer used to walk with every load due to vinyl flooring. Added this product and the washer does not move at all. Great product!

OMG! We love these pads!! We had coretec floors put in 2 yes ago and the washer was noisy and slid out of place all the time.  3 days with these guys in place and I haven't had any issues. Thing to note...the elevation of machine with feet in place may be a problem for someone with a fixed over appliance counter.

Work great, I have a washer that always vibrates like crazy, it’s hard to level due to a broken peg. Only down fall is the pads smell horrible, my laundry room smells like a just smoked a pack of cigarettes in there with the door closed. We’re going to try and re wash them and leave them out in the sun. Not sure if I was the only unlucky one but they smell, as soon as you open the packaging it hits you. Besides that they work great!
These made a remarkable difference in the vibrations from the washing machine.

Never had problem with washer until new flooring was installed.  Since the new flooring is kind of slick, unlike previous cushion vinyl, washer was sometimes walking.  These Steady Pads have stopped the walking so I am very pleased with them.

HAPPY !  Now put a set of pads under our new double laundry tub' s metal legs to isolate the metal from the concrete floor...these simple pads WORK GREAT !!!! Haven’t been this excited abt a purchase in a long time. Washer only a few yrs old. No matter how we arranged a load (towels, blankets, or delicates), our top-load washer would make this horrifying, house-shaking sound during the spin cycles. Worse than a T-storm- no joke. Would have to place it back into position after every load. Honestly, the worst part was that our beloved dog would tremble & become so frightened by this noise- would break my heart to do laundry. She would hide as soon as she heard the washer turn on 😢
While researching how to repair problem, I came across these WONDER PADS & thought I’d give them a try. Installed pads easily myself, & threw in a large load of towels. NO noise whatsoever. Best part was my fur-buddy had no idea the washer was even running, so no more laundry terror for her. Thank you for such an amazing product- wish I’d found them sooner!

These STEADY-PADS replaced the ones I bought when I first purchased my LG small washer/dryer combo in June,2015. The old ones were flat blocks that were hard and worn out. These new STEADY/PADS were installed today. My son did all the installation by himself. So I would say they were easy to install. I did one load of laundry and was amazed how much quieter the machine ran, less vibration and no walking. I'm  very pleased with this purchase. I like it that the leg on the machine fits into the pad so it will not slip off like on the old one. Wish I had ordered them sooner.  Very happy with this product as well as the transaction!

Just be advised that, at least on my LG W/D, the pads stick out past the sides of my machine by 1/2" on the left and right so if your units are built in tight, they may interfere with the wall or neighboring cabinet. Seems like a good product so long as it fits in your space.

But if you're looking to keep your washer and dryer in the same place, these will do the trick. A little pricey, but you get what you pay for!

Our front loading Samsung washer has always walked around the laundry room floor. I can't count the number of times I've leveled it, messed with the feet, etc. Then I ran across these and the idea made perfect sense, so I decided to try them. There are several brands and I chose these because 1) they had a deep well for the foot to sit in, 2) the texture on the bottom looked least likely to walk, and 3) they looked very sturdy. They also had excellent reviews. We've run at least a dozen loads of laundry since putting them on, and the washer has remained in exactly the same place it started. They were a bit of a pain to position just right, but that's not the fault of the product. It's just hard to get the rear ones in place because of the way to washer sits next to the wall on one side and the dryer on the other. It took two of us and we needed a long hook for one of us to push and pull the foot pad with while the other one held one side (at a time) of the washer off the floor. Still, it took no more time to do this than it did every time I messed with the feet before, and these actually solved the problem. I couldn't be happier.

These did exactly as advertised. They lowered vibration and stopped the washer from walking across the floor, plus an added convenience, they raised the washer off the floor and can be dusted underneath. I am most satisfied

We got a Samsung front loading washer and dryer set about four years ago that under most circumstances we love....until I run it on a long spin cycle. I’ve spent the last four years balancing it, running the legs as flat to the bottom as they’ll go, fully extended, etc. during the wind up and wind down it sounds like our ceiling is going to fall in on us (our washroom is on the second floor). Once it’s at full speed no worries. But wow is it loud. I finally just took for granted it’s just going to do it and let it go.
Our washer has a timer so I like to set it up at night to run in the morning when we leave. Our next door neighbor was out on her porch and heard it winding up, freaked out and called us. I ran home anyway just to make sure it was ok, and sure enough it was the washer.
Enough is enough so I called in a professional...I Googled it. Sure enough there’s enough info out there that I felt relieved it wasn’t just us, and got plenty of advice to fix it. Having tried all the other “home cures,” I hopped on Amazon and ordered these. They sat on the table for a week until I got motivated to set them in place.
So I leveled the washer again, and then put these under the legs (all I did was use the side handle to tilt the washer one way, drop two legs in and then repeat from the other side....simple). I ran a load at full spin...I had to come upstairs and make sure the washer was working. No vibration, no walking. I couldn’t believe it. So I let

I made sure the washer was level, but it made no difference.  After installing this product, no more moving around.  They do raise the machine about 1.5 inches, so we bought a set for the dryer so the two machines are level with each other.  Not necessary, just our preference.  Not sure if they actually made the washer and dryer quieter, but the washer has not moved at all since we added the pads.

Now with these pads installed, we can’t hardly tell when the unit is running. Amazing, totally works as advertised

I have no idea why other options cost so much.

So, there's quite a bit of motion with one. Ours had actually scooted itself across the floor to the point that it pulled its plug from the outlet, much like an old 70s sitcom. We put these under the feet and it runs like a champ now. Even when it's at max spin on the dry cycle, we have zero shifting and very smooth quiet operation.

Never thought these would work but very happy they work great! Our washer would walk and/or jump around ending up slamming against the dryer. Great investment!  Cuts down on noise.  Works well.

Solid & sturdy, & now I can have peace & quiet without sounding like there's an earthquake going on every time I do laundry, which is like 3-4x or more a week.

Our newer washing machine, heavy duty, is suppose to balance uneven loads....it would dance around the concrete basement floor like it was having a seizure. Put these on the feet, washing machine shakes but doesn't walk around or sound like its going to explode anymore. Highly recommend these!!

The pads themselves are huge, heavy, and solid. Think hockey puck but thicker and heavier. Solid grip on the floor and no vibrations at all! Excellent!

Also, heres a trick if you need to slide your appliance back after putting it on these ... get some windex or similar cleaner and spray the pad and floor near it. They'll slide nicely, then stick once the cleaner evaporates.

I was surprised at how hard the rubber is, I was hoping that it was softer to better isolate the vibration.

Heavy duty.  The pads have made a significant difference and my wife is happy, so I am happy.

OK we have a Whirlpool Duet Sport washing machine that sits on a pedestal riser/drawer. It rests on a wooden floor with vinyl flooring over a basement.  It would WALK all over the laundry room. I had to consistently move it back to its original position sometimes more than a foot or so as well as it was twisting around. Over the years technicians have come out from the appliance store and basically said the problem was the wooden floor over a basement and the pedestal base. I purchased these Steady -Pad anti-walk and vibration foot pads and they worked great!! The washer hasn't moved after about 6 loads of laundry including my nemesis which is washing all the bathroom rugs at the same time. I do not think the washer has moved even an 1/8th of an inch from its original position. I'm not sure at this point about the vibration or noise being less but the walking is gone! A remarkable product that does what is designed to do. I forgot to say that I did make sure it was level but it was very close to start..

Have purchased other similar products that have curled under the movement of the washer.  The washer moved only slightly when off balance due to the thickness of the rubber feet.  These are more expensive but well worth the price!

My husband titled the washer while I slid them under the feet.  We ran the washer on the heaviest spin and it was super quiet.  I'm so thankful to have found this solution!

Haven’t tried washing large and bulky sheets yet but I’m hopeful. Highly recommend.

Unexpectedly, the washer does seem to “bounce” up and down a lot more, which I guess is the effect from the rubber feet. So while the washer is quieter and no longer creeps, any items I put on tops of the washer bounces around moves a lot more. Probably some harmonic effect going on.

Overall I think it’s great.
These work GREAT! Even though my washer still makes crazy noises. Doesn’t walk. Made a huge difference.

had to place these under washer and dryer on top of pedestals. large and won't move.

Good

I bought these as a last resort for our Samsung washing machine (on a pedestal).  I’ve leveled the thing a dozen times, calibrated the vibration dampening at least a half dozen times, had a tech come look at it and was on the verge of taking it back to the store.  These dampeners solved our issues with the washer, I wish I would have known about them sooner.  The washer is running now I didn’t even notice it.

I have a home office below our laundry room, and our washing machine has grown increasingly loud over the past six month - so much so that at several periods during the spin cycle I'd have to mute my microphone on conference calls because it was just so darn loud!

Out of sheer desperation and trying to avoid a $200 visit from the repair person who might not actually fix the problem, I ordered these. They were easy enough to install, but the feet of our Samsung washing machine didn't fit inside them properly - the feet were too big, and as a result they sort of sit on top. I was quite skeptical these would do anything, but I was so very wrong. They are AMAZING.
